title: Non-Coding Transcriptome Provides Novel Insights into the Escherichia coli F17 Susceptibility of Sheep Lamb
summary: RNA-seq plus random-forest/XGBoost feature selection identified ncRNA associations with E. coli F17 susceptibility in challenged lambs. The measured association is exploratory and does not show causal ncRNA function.

evidence.tested: RNA-seq plus random-forest/XGBoost feature selection identified ncRNA associations with E. coli F17 susceptibility in challenged lambs. The measured association is exploratory and does not show causal ncRNA function.
